metaDescription: Follow the historic route from Gallipoli and Troy to Pergamon, Ephesus and Pamukkale on a six-day journey through western Turkey's remarkable past.

6-Day Gallipoli & Ancient Cities of Turkey Tour
summary:
The 6-Day Istanbul, Ephesus, Pergamon, Troy & Gallipoli Tour traces Turkey’s history from the Ottoman and Byzantine monuments of Istanbul to some of the country’s most important ancient sites. Walk through Ephesus, climb to the Acropolis of Pergamon and explore the legendary ruins of Troy before continuing to the Gallipoli Peninsula and its First World War battlefields and memorials.
Choose the departure date that suits your plans, and we can adapt the program where needed. We arrange 4-star accommodation with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, one domestic flight, airport transfers, entrance fees and all scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir & Ephesus tour
itinerary.text:
At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00.
Upon arrival at 08:10, meet your guide and continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the impressive Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the sacred House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pergamon tour and then to Canakkale
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, depart for Pergamon and explore its impressive Acropolis, including the Temple of Athena, the ancient Library, Royal Palaces, Temple of Trajan, Temple of Dionysos, Altar of Zeus, and the world’s steepest ancient theatre. Enjoy views of the Red Basilica before lunch in town. After the tour, continue to Canakkale. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: Troy & Gallipoli Tour and then to Istanbul
itinerary.text: Visit the ancient city of Troy, including the famous Trojan Horse, city walls, Temple of Athena, Roman Baths, and Odeon while learning about the legends of the Trojan Wars. Continue to Eceabat for lunch before the guided Gallipoli campaign Battlefields Tour, visiting Anzac Cove, Lone Pine Memorial, Johnston’s Jolly, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair. After the tour, transfer to Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your departure flight.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 6-Day Ephesus, Troy & Gallipoli Trip?
faqs.a: The 6-Day Ephesus, Troy & Gallipoli Trip covers Istanbul, Ephesus, Pergamon, Troy, and Gallipoli. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, visit the ancient city of Ephesus, discover the impressive Acropolis of Pergamon, learn about the legendary city of Troy, and pay tribute at the Gallipoli battlefields and memorials. The tour combines history, archaeology, and culture in one memorable journey.

faqs.q: How much does the 6-Day Ephesus, Troy & Gallipoli Trip cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,195 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, one domestic flight, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Is a domestic flight included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes one domestic flight as specified in the itinerary. This flight helps reduce travel time and allows you to focus more on sightseeing and experiencing Turkey's most important historical destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 4 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 6-day trip include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical context, local insights, and expert commentary throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors interested in Turkey's rich history. It combines some of the country's most important archaeological sites with the significant battlefields of Gallipoli, offering a deeper understanding of Turkey's past.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, museums, and memorial areas. Locations such as Ephesus, Pergamon, Troy, and Gallipoli involve walking on uneven ground, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Pergamon, Troy, and Gallipoli?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis of Pergamon, the ancient ruins and legendary Trojan Horse of Troy, and the battlefields, cemeteries, and memorials of Gallipoli. These sites provide a fascinating journey through thousands of years of history, from ancient civilizations to World War I.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Ephesus, Troy & Gallipoli Trip?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 6-Day Ephesus, Troy & Gallipoli Trip available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights in Istanbul, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
